domains.name: Sales Methodologies and Consultative Selling
domains.description: Sales methodologies and consultative selling: SaaS economics/KPIs, pain-point diagnosis, and structured discovery (Sandler, SPIN).

domains.name: Negotiation and Closing Techniques
domains.description: Negotiation and closing: objection handling, pricing/contract strategy, commercial insight, and persuasive presentation and closing.

domains.name: Lead Generation, Prospecting, and Tracking
domains.description: Lead generation, prospecting, and tracking: research, cold outreach, email sequences, CRM operation, and pipeline qualification.

domains.name: Relationship Management and Customer Success
domains.description: Relationship management and customer success: long-term relationships, active listening, CRM hygiene/forecasting, and data-driven adjustment.

competencies.statement: The learner can explain SaaS revenue models, customer acquisition cost, and key sales KPIs, and use them to frame a deal.
competencies.description: Interprets SaaS economics/KPIs and applies them in qualifying or positioning a sale.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze a customer's pain points and match them to appropriate software solutions.
competencies.description: Diagnoses a stated business problem and maps it to a product capability.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply the Sandler method — including rapport-building and pain-point discovery — in a sales conversation.
competencies.description: Runs a Sandler-style discovery conversation correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can use SPIN Selling (Situation, Problem, Implication, Need-Payoff) to guide a consultative conversation.
competencies.description: Sequences SPIN questions appropriately to surface need.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply negotiation tactics to handle objections and secure favorable deals.
competencies.description: Chooses an effective response to a negotiation objection.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop a strategy for a contract negotiation and pricing discussion.
competencies.description: Plans concessions/anchors for a pricing negotiation.

competencies.statement: The learner can reframe a customer's thinking and present a commercial insight effectively.
competencies.description: Delivers a challenger-style insight that reframes the buyer's view.

competencies.statement: The learner can design a compelling sales presentation that uses data visualization and storytelling.
competencies.description: Structures a deck that pairs a narrative with clear visuals.

competencies.statement: The learner can deliver a persuasive sales pitch, handle objections, and move toward a close.
competencies.description: Advances a pitch to a clear next step or close.

competencies.statement: The learner can identify and research potential leads using market analysis and prospecting techniques.
competencies.description: Builds a qualified target list from market signals.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct an effective cold call and handle objections during it.
competencies.description: Opens, navigates, and recovers a cold call.

competencies.statement: The learner can craft an email outreach sequence that sets appointments.
competencies.description: Writes a multi-touch sequence with a clear call to action.

competencies.statement: The learner can operate a CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) to track leads and sales conversion.
competencies.description: Records and advances opportunities correctly in a CRM.

competencies.statement: The learner can use prospecting tools to build and qualify a sales pipeline.
competencies.description: Applies a qualification framework to build pipeline.

competencies.statement: The learner can build long-term relationships with prospects and customers to sustain success.
competencies.description: Plans touchpoints that maintain a customer relationship over time.

competencies.statement: The learner can use active listening and consultative discussion to align solutions with customer needs.
competencies.description: Demonstrates listening that surfaces and confirms need.

competencies.statement: The learner can maintain and update sales opportunities in a CRM to support accurate forecasting.
competencies.description: Keeps opportunity stages/data current for a reliable forecast.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze sales data to identify trends and adjust strategy.
competencies.description: Reads pipeline/performance data and adapts approach.
